releaseNotes:
v1.4.9 - Welcome + Quiz UI Polish + Daily 5 + Shortcuts + Reminder Fixes:

- Redesigned welcome screen: gradient hero with brand logo glow, 3 feature pills (Audio/Offline/Quizzes), cleaner single-column form
- Redesigned quit quiz dialog: side-by-side Quit/Keep going buttons, pause icon, calmer tone
- Daily 5 now works: connected to 38 real vocabulary words (Animals, Birds, Colors, Shapes) with spaced repetition, XP rewards, combo tracking
- Home screen shortcuts: long-press app icon for Take a Quiz, Ask Anywaa AI, Share App
- Reminder fixes: fixed date calculation bug at month boundaries, added Android 12+ exact alarm permissions, fixed toggle ON/OFF state sync, added user feedback toasts, re-request permission on time change
- Share link updated to v1.4.9 (GitHub APK only, no netlify)
- All emoji-free
